lines.text: 逃向南方的颜色太鲜艳，结局只能用火药收场。
lines.en: The colors of fleeing south are too vivid — the ending can only be settled with gunpowder.
lines.character: 费迪南／玛丽安娜 / Ferdinand / Marianne
